purpose: Define each `#SHOP` shopping list as an explicit planning identity with stable ownership/scope, lifecycle and item membership separate from any merchant cart or purchase transaction.

topics.name: Shopping List Identity
topics.purpose: Define each `#SHOP` shopping list as an explicit planning identity with stable ownership/scope, lifecycle and item membership separate from any merchant cart or purchase transaction.

semantics.identity_rule: Every shopping list has an explicit stable identity.
semantics.scope_rule: Owner/user/project/household or other list scope is explicit.
semantics.membership_rule: Items are explicit members/refs of the list.
semantics.merchant_rule: Shopping-list identity is separate from merchant/cart/order identity.
semantics.studio_rule: Studio Everyday may project/edit shopping lists but does not own #SHOP semantics.
semantics.authority_rule: List ownership/visibility does not grant purchase/payment authority.

invariants.rule: Shopping-list data expresses planning intent only; list/item existence, ranking, recommendation or selection never authorizes purchase, payment or external order execution.

hard_gates.condition: merchant cart used as canonical shopping-list identity
item membership inferred only from UI nesting

prose.summary: Define each `#SHOP` shopping list as an explicit planning identity with stable ownership/scope, lifecycle and item membership separate from any merchant cart or purchase transaction.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against #SHOP owner, Studio Everyday, units and external procurement/payment contracts.
